heading: All error codes
text:
### All error codes [LNLS.9.2]

| Code | Paragraph | Condition |
|---|---|---|
| LNLS.3.1 | JSON slot type | Schema has `json`-typed slot used under `linear_scan: false` |
| LNLS.3.2 | Novel string | an interpolated string may produce a non-interned string |
| LNLS.3.3a | Non-identity EQ anchor | Cross-pattern equality not on identity slot of both schemas |
| LNLS.3.3b | TTL schema in join | Multi-pattern join includes a `ttl`-lifecycle schema |
| LNLS.3.3c | Unanchored pattern | A pattern after the first, positive or negated, is not anchored to an earlier one; or a singleton slot an anchor uses is nullable |
| LNLS.3.5 | Sketch backend | Series aggregation requires O(n) sketch |
| LNLS.3.7 | Unbounded regex | `~`/`!~` on slot without `capacity` |
| LNLS.3.8 | String ordering in join | `<`/`>`/`<=`/`>=` on String in cross-pattern position |
| LNLS.3.9 | JSON path | Any JSON path expression |
| LNLS.3.10 | Unbounded string op | String operation on slot without `capacity` |
